1. Frontend Architecture & Technology Stack

The Frontend tier of the Employee Onboarding and Statutory HR Management System is engineered as a modern, high-performance Single Page Application (SPA) leveraging React 18.3 and Vite 8.0. The user interface adheres strictly to component-driven design principles, ensuring granular state encapsulation, responsive layouts across desktop and mobile devices, and atomic separation of presentation logic from data-fetching pipelines.

Technology / Layer Library & Version Architectural Purpose & Implementation Details
Core Framework React 18.3.1 Declarative, component-driven UI library utilizing React Concurrent Mode and functional hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback).
Build & Bundling Vite 8.0.0 Next-generation frontend tooling providing lightning-fast Hot Module Replacement (HMR) and optimized Rollup production builds.
Styling & Design System Tailwind CSS 3.4.1 Utility-first CSS framework enabling consistent spacing, professional color palettes, fluid typography, and mobile-first responsive grid layouts.
Iconography Lucide React 0.344 Comprehensive, clean, and accessible SVG icon suite ensuring visual consistency across menus, KPI cards, and operational status badges.
HTTP Client & Networking Axios 1.6.8 Promise-based HTTP client preconfigured with global request/response interceptors that automatically inject JWT bearer tokens into API calls.
Client-Side Routing React Router DOM 6.22 Declarative client-side routing with nested layout wrappers and role-based route authentication guards (RoleGuard.jsx).

2. Component Tree & Directory Structure

The frontend codebase is organized into modular directory boundaries promoting maintainability and reusability:

  • frontend/src/
    • ├── assets/: Static image assets, SVG branding, and college seal icons.
    • ├── components/: Reusable UI widgets (Header, Sidebar, StatCard, DataTable, ModalDrawer).
    • ├── context/: React Context providers for authentication state (AuthContext.jsx).
    • ├── pages/: Top-level views corresponding to system features (Dashboard, Onboarding, Payroll, etc.).
    • ├── services/: Dedicated Axios API client services (authService.js, payrollService.js).
    • ├── utils/: Currency formatters, date transformers, and Indian statutory tax calculator helpers.
    • └── App.jsx: Top-level route switchboard and security boundary provider.

3. Multi-Persona User Interface Design & RBAC Routing

To maintain strict zero-trust security and prevent privilege escalation, the frontend implements dynamic Route Guards and persona-adaptive navigation menus. When an authenticated user logs in, the application decodes their cryptographic JWT payload and dynamically renders only the feature links and API execution buttons permitted for their role:

1. Super Admin Viewport

Unrestricted governance over global configurations and system logs.

  • Statutory Configuration Console (FR12 Engine)
  • System User Credential & Role Management
  • Immutable Audit Log Trail Viewer
  • Database Health & Referential Integrity Monitor
2. HR Administrator Viewport

Operational control over candidate recruitment, employees, and payroll.

  • Candidate 7-Stage Digital Onboarding & KYC
  • Master Employee Directory with Profile Drawers
  • Monthly Batch Statutory Payroll Calculation
  • 1-Click EPFO ECR & ESIC Return Generation
3. Department Manager Viewport

Supervisory access over team rosters and performance reviews.

  • Team Shift Roster & Punctuality Dashboard
  • Interactive Leave Request Approval Queue
  • Attendance Regularization Authorization
  • Annual Employee Performance Appraisal Matrix
4. Employee (ESS) Viewport

Self-service workstation for personal workplace activities.

  • Web Punch Shift Check-in / Check-out
  • Leave Quota Balance Cards (CL, SL, EL)
  • Monthly Payslip Download in PDF Format
  • Income Tax Form 12BB Investment Declaration

5. Responsive Design, Accessibility & Performance

The frontend platform is engineered to comply with enterprise usability standards, ensuring seamless operation across varying form factors:

Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant)
  • High-contrast color tokens exceeding the 4.5:1 luminance ratio for text clarity.
  • Full keyboard navigability across navigation menus, modal windows, and data tables.
  • Descriptive ARIA labels on interactive icon buttons and data entry elements.
Performance & Bundle Optimization
  • Route-level dynamic code splitting via React.lazy() and Suspense.
  • Static asset pre-compression reducing initial bundle size to under 180 KB.
  • Debounced search inputs preventing redundant HTTP requests during live filtering.
